I'll look through the project notes and current state so I can say what's still open.Open items as of 11 November, from the 3 November minutes and the member list:

- Committee members send Tessa comments on the winter closing checklist (due 10 November).
- Paolo chases the roofer about the extra $80 (due 10 November). Pay the $1,560 invoice only after that charge is explained.
- Ibrahim sends the 14 November work-day notice to all members (deadline was 7 November).
- Work day is Saturday 14 November, 09:30–12:30. The tool sharpener comes at 10:00. Wren shuts the water off that day. Members bring gloves; the club supplies soup.
- Dov calls the city again about the second tap by 17 November.
- Collect Leontyne Quist’s unpaid $45 fee. Process Sabela Pascoe’s $45 refund (moved away 1 October).
- Close the garden at the end of November. No further meetings this year.

Autumn fee tracking is still pending. Leontyne Quist remains unpaid. Sabela Pascoe may need a refund processed. There is also a duplicate Bram Lindqvist record and an Idris Rasku payment missing decimals.

The noticeboard was painted in September. Night rate electricity was moved in August. Roof quotes were booked and installed. Fee reminders were sent in September. Compost was ordered and arrived. The gate latch was replaced in October.
